styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating deep-black speckled textured stages #0A0A0A and clean white infographic panels #FFFFFF, one solid orange #F26F21 comfort scene, one light grey #F7F7F7 variant panel; cool tech-blue glow #35C6FF reserved for chip and sound-energy graphics only
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio key from upper left with controlled cool rim light on product edges, low-key glow-driven lighting on black stages, bright even high-key on white panels, soft grounded contact shadows, no mixed light directions
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte speckled black stage texture, smooth white paper panels, dark charcoal console surface for scene shots
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; white headlines on dark panels, charcoal #2D2D2D headlines on white panels; short headline type only, no dense body text
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line white icons inside consistent dark circular badges #111111
styleLock.presentationRules: stable front 3/4 hero angle for packshots, consistent product scale across the set, centered stability on infographic panels, grounded contact shadow at all times, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
noDrift: no floating product without contact shadow
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium tech audio ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep speckled black #0A0A0A, clean white #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2D2D2D, vivid orange accent #F26F21, and cool tech-blue glow #35C6FF reserved for chip and sound-energy graphics; neutral temperature with cool glowing accents on dark stages; modern geometric sans-serif headline type; alternating deep-black textured stages and clean white infographic panels; soft diffused studio key from upper left with controlled cool rim light and grounded contact shadows; consistent dark circular thin-line icon badges; stable product scale with centered stability; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 源图来自「数码」文件夹、文件名为「耳机 (1)」，画面实际主产品为头戴式蓝牙耳机，与文件名相符，故归类手机数码/耳机音频。10 张详情页切片（800×1200，重叠 60px）拼合分析：开场深黑主视觉、白色结构卖点、芯片对比、降噪卖点、图标行+驱动微距、打碟台场景、橙色舒适场景、参数表。已剥离：画面英文品牌字与型号名、参数表中的品牌值、模特面部身份、店铺会员二维码与促销角标；所有参数数字与卖点文案一律走 {selling_point}/{callout} 文案槽由使用方填写，未发明任何认证/数据。源图同时出现亮黑与黑银两种配色且型号标注不一致，模版按同一头戴蓝牙耳机家族合并为双色 VARIANT。
